author: Stealthbomber16
body:
I have a map I've been working on (ready to be released soon) but I have a question about posting it.

Instead of posting pictures of the map, may I make a trailer-style video about how the map looks using my bandicam?

Its a slightly big map, but I should be able to cover most of the areas with 1-2 minutes of filming.

Thanks,
-Squid King Stealth
